dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Some people were doing a poll outside the station, and they stopped me.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ˈpiːpəl wɜːr ˈduːɪŋ ə ˈpoʊl ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ənd ðeɪ ˈstɑːpt miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Public transportation. First, they asked me if I took the train every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈpʌblɪk ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən. ˈfɜːrst, ðeɪ ˈæskt miː ɪf aɪ ˈtʊk ðə ˈtreɪn ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I said no, only on weekends. Then they asked whether the tickets were too expensive.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsɛd ˈnoʊ, ˈoʊnli ɑːn ˈwiːkɛndz. ˈðɛn ðeɪ ˈæskt ˈwɛðər ðə ˈtɪkɪts wɜːr ˈtuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: They are expensive! Did they ask for your opinion about the buses, too?
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ər ɪkˈspɛnsɪv! dɪd ðeɪ ˈæsk fər jʊr əˈpɪnjən əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbʌsɪz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. They asked whether I felt safe on the bus at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪ ˈæskt ˈwɛðər aɪ ˈfɛlt ˈseɪf ɑːn ðə ˈbʌs ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Will they share the poll with the public?
dialogue.reading: wɪl ðeɪ ˈʃɛr ðə ˈpoʊl wɪð ðə ˈpʌblɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. They said it would be on their website next week.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðeɪ ˈsɛd ɪt wʊd bi ɑːn ðɛr ˈwɛbsaɪt ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope the majority of people say the tickets are too expensive!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðə məˈdʒɔːrəti əv ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ðə ˈtɪkɪts ər ˈtuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv!
